integrity: Original arithmetic threshold and explicit cycle proof, with dependency on cited published graph-word theorem; finite reproducibility checks supplement, not replace, the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Integer bases b>=2 and nonnegative integer shifts d only; nonextremal complexity given as strict lower bound at one pattern size, not exact at all sizes. Uses established graph characterization, no independent validation.
title: A sharp shift threshold for Abelian pattern Sturmian power words
